verdict.rationale: GitHub documents cloud and local sandboxes that give Copilot isolated execution environments for code, tools, filesystem, and network access (github-docs-58). It also offers cloud-based dev environments (github-docs-3), and the cloud agent works on a separate branch before any PR is merged (github-docs-26). This supports safe, isolated testing, but the evidence is a single thin mention with no detail on keeping production data separate. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a test/sandbox mode separated from production data, details on sandbox configuration and data isolation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
